title: How often local councils meet and how many measures they take up
usableAnswer: A table by government type (council-manager, mayor-council, commission, town meeting, county board) and population band giving meetings per year, measures introduced per year, share adopted, rejected and tabled, each with a named public source (state municipal league surveys, ICMA, municipal clerk annual reports, or a sampled set of published council minutes) and its year.
whyItMatters: The game's local councils meet on one fixed interval and introduce one ordinance per meeting in every town, so a town of 800 and a city of 800,000 legislate at the same pace and measure numbers run at an invented rate.

answer.summary: The existing official-source throughput sample separately reports Minneapolis ordinance introduction/enactment/codification and county adopted/listed ordinances; these are not a representative town-size/type grid. R22 republishes bounded government observations with source/vintage.
